So how do you change your domain name without losing SEO? It comes down to three steps. But before the steps, one thing most people get wrong.

Google doesn't rank your domain. It ranks your pages. To Google, Frosty Fusion is a list of addresses. The homepage. The flavor menu. And that famous page: get frosty fusion dot com slash flavors slash strawberry. Each page has its own history. How long it has ranked, and who links to it. Change the domain, and every one of those addresses changes too. The new ones start with no history. So the job isn't moving a domain. It's moving every page, in a way Google can follow.
